commit.style: Subjects are lower-case and written as a short descriptive sentence prefixed by the GitHub issue number and a colon, ending with that issue's #N reference (e.g. "146: the hearth is friends, campaigns, characters and one Lore list #146"), with occasional plain subjects like "Update the board" for board-sync commits; no feat:/fix: prefixes, scopes, or body trailers are used.
